item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find convincing 2024 evidence that Sharif broadly allowed peaceful protest or dissent without retaliation. The only affirmative material I found was narrow and local, while the more reliable reporting points to a pattern of protest crackdowns, internet shutdowns, and selective punishment.","evidence":[{"title":"PM urges AJK govt, political leadership to resolve issues through dialogue","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-05-12","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/12-05-2024/pm-shehbaz-urges-ajk-govt-political-leadership-to-resolve-issues-through-dialogue","summary":"Sharif told party and local leaders in Azad Kashmir to talk with the action committee and resolve the dispute peacefully. This is the best positive item, but it is narrow and does not amount to a general pro-dissent or pro-protest posture.","question_ids":["3B.8","2B.7","3B.6"]},{"title":"Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on peoples' rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"Amnesty condemned the telecom and mobile internet shutdown as a rights violation during the election period. This is direct evidence of retaliation-capable control that chilled public participation and dissent around Sharif’s ascent.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Pakistan: the new Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act threatens the right to protest","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-09","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/pakistan-the-new-peaceful-assembly-and-public-order-act-threatens-the-right-to-protest/","summary":"Amnesty said the new law was rushed through and would criminalize peaceful assembly rather than align protest rules with human-rights standards. That is strong evidence against a permissive stance toward peaceful protest and dissent.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Pakistan Government Intensifies Crackdown on Political Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-09","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent","summary":"HRW reported over 500 arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, mobile internet cuts, and arrests of people protesting peacefully. This is the clearest evidence that protest was met with retaliation and collective restriction rather than toleration.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Pakistani police detain two parliamentarians in swoop on ex-PM Khan's party","publisher":"Reuters / ThePrint","date":"2024-09-10","url":"https://theprint.in/world/pakistani-police-detain-two-parliamentarians-in-swoop-on-ex-pm-khans-party/2260202/","summary":"Police detained PTI parliamentarians after a rally demanding Khan’s release. That supports a pattern of selective punishment against political dissent rather than neutral policing.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.2","3B.5"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Urgent and transparent investigation needed into deadly crackdown on opposition protesters","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-27","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/urgent-and-transparent-investigation-needed-into-deadly-crackdown-on-opposition-protesters/","summary":"Amnesty said the Islamabad crackdown on PTI protesters involved deaths, mass detentions, mobile internet shutdowns, and a pattern of intolerance for peaceful assembly. This is strong evidence that peaceful protest was not being protected.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"A dangerous digital crackdown","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-12","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/12/dangerous-digital-crackdown","summary":"HRW said internet shutdowns and VPN restrictions had become default policing tools to shut down protests and criticism, while a PECA-linked body would expand prosecution powers. This supports a chilling-surveillance and administrative-restriction reading, not a freedom-to-organize reading.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Pakistan authorities must end escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-21","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/","summary":"Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and orders blocking Ahmadi rites. While this is also a minority-protection issue, it is relevant here because community organization and religious practice were met with punitive restriction.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.7"]}]}
